summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime release from github.com/oven-sh/bun, unzips it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and immediately execFileSyncs it against a bundled `math_init.js` file. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex-renamed identifiers (`_0x...`), string dictionaries, and a shuffled string-array bootstrap. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are not inspectable by Node-based tooling. The package is nominally a jest configuration for React Native and has no functional need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated compiled payload at install time. The combination of an alternate-runtime download + obfuscated compiled payload execution + purpose mismatch is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: Bun is fetched not to run the package's own declared code but to execute an opaque bundle whose bytecode evades JavaScript-level static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
